Macca the Gator is going to be a core piece of in game IP. Some indicators of its significance in GTA6 are the following:

1) He is plastered over the physical IRL merch (T-shirt sold out and 2/3 of the items in the GTA6 collectors bundle have Macca on them)

3) He will be the host of what I assume is a talk show on the weazel news station (Show name is Macca and friends) Seems like he’ll be replacing lazlow in GTA6 so my assumption is that a lot of the comedic and satirical writing efforts will be going into that show, and he’ll be the voice behind a lot of clips that go viral 

4) Safe to assume there will be a lot of premium macca themed cosmetics in the game, ie car decals and weapon skins, phone background, clothing etc 

5) He is set up to be a persistent character of significance throughout the game. Other things like DaCity coin, in my opinion are more likely to be featured in a 3-5 mission series and then more or less discarded as story artifacts 

6) Aside from Jason and Lucia, there are no other named characters that rockstar has deliberately advertised to this extent

I don’t even really believe in memecoins/chasing virality and attention etc but IF something in the GTA 6 meta is gonna be a dominant runner, it really seems like Macca is set up better than anything else
